listing.name: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey (WG3D Recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Windows package; original USA v1.0 ROM Limits: Specific ROM SHA-1 in README; native N64 runtime and launcher documented. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 package generated by upstream release script; no other established player package. Original data: Own Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey N64 USA version 1.0 ROM, SHA-1 400aa84811f1f2f6c62c756b43b54d534d5a5ec8. Runtime target is big-endian .z64; upstream rom_prep.py normalizes supported alternate byte orders and verifies SHA-1/CIC. Other revisions are not the documented target. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
